findings.item: Released package free of secrets and absolute paths
findings.why: Secrets are out of scope for this repository -- every .py in src/ was checked and none reads or embeds a credential -- but the RELEASED package has to be confirmed clean at the moment it is published, including any file copied in from elsewhere.

Every table needs a path from the released repo to the number; the results exist, the public location does not yet. The manuscript's \repourl macro carries a visible placeholder until it is set, so the PDF cannot be submitted with a stale link.

findings.item: Timing claim not resting on one machine pair
findings.evidence: manuscript states the single-hardware caveat explicitly
findings.why: The cost model makes the claim hardware-independent in FLOPs, which is the right defence; a second machine pair would make it a measurement rather than a model.

findings.item: No unfinished placeholders in the manuscript body
findings.why: A submission carrying 'repository link to be added' cannot be uploaded as-is, and a journal copy-editor will not chase it.

findings.item: Reference list sized for a journal
findings.evidence: 60 entries in refs.bib, 57 \cite commands in main.tex
findings.why: Journal reviews in this area typically see 40-60+ references; a short list reads as an under-positioned contribution and invites 'the authors appear unaware of ...'.

findings.item: Figure count appropriate to a journal paper
findings.why: A results paper with no figure asks the reader to reconstruct every trend from tables. It is survivable but it is the first thing a referee asks for.

findings.item: Deep BSDE benchmarked, not merely cited
findings.evidence: cited=True, solver class in solvers.py=True, table \input in manuscript=True, measurements on disk=True, result files=21
findings.why: Deep BSDE is THE standard high-dimensional method in mathematical finance. A comparison paper that cites it and does not run it will be asked why by the first referee, and the honest answer -- that the PINN was easier to run -- is not one that helps the paper. All three of run/wired/in-manuscript are required: results on disk with no table is the state this check was written to catch.

findings.item: Current paper's numbers are traceable to results/
findings.evidence: verified: 93/93 prose assertions match, all 12 tables reproduce digit-for-digit, 0 unmatched
findings.why: This replaces an earlier MANUAL item that asked the authors to source six conclusions from the ORIGINAL THESIS. That item was removed when the thesis was put out of scope: nothing in this paper cites or reproduces those conclusions, and the paper's own traceability is checked mechanically by verify_paper_numbers.py and check_table_drift.py instead of being asserted.
